title: Juicy Tender Brazilian Beef Tagine
description: A fermented and tender Brazilian dish featuring rosemary and cooked in a tagine, perfect for a midnight craving, this paleo-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your hunger.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the beef, rosemary, garlic, onion, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld.
Remove the beef from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Heat the coconut oil in the bottom of a tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the beef to the tagine and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the bay leaves to the tagine and cover with a lid.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
